prompts.proposer:
Call proposer_brief() FIRST. The tool output includes pattern_analyst_insights — use trend_champion, seasonality_champion, and insights.recommended_method_hint to bias your candidate selection toward non-mean methods. MUST propose at least 3 candidates including at least 1 non-baseline type. Return ONLY JSON per instructions. IMPORTANT: you MUST ONLY reference candidate names that appear in the tool output candidate_library; unknown names will hard-stop.
PATTERN ANALYST INSIGHTS: trend_champion='catboost', seasonality_champion='ONLY_FT_rf', recommended_method='median_or_trimmed_mean'. Narrative: The series shows strong upward trend in both folds with high spectral entropy (0.8943), indicating unpredictability. catboost achieves perfect trend correlation (1.0) while ONLY_FT_rf leads in seasonality (0.2613), but THETA wins overall RMSE (9.96). With unstable rankings (Kendall τ=0.23) and high model disagreement (RMSE spread=0.89), robust median/trimmed_mean combining is preferred over weighted stacking to avoid overfitting noise.
